summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides a persistent Design Studio experience with live preview, enabling design-file management and element-based edits through coordinated AI flows with DeepSeek and a design agent.

classificationSuggestion.reason: Primary purpose is an AI-assisted design workflow plugin for the DeepSeek Harness: it adds a persistent Design Studio UI, a live design preview route, an element-picker edit flow, and a design_studio agent tool for managing mockup files in temp_design_folder, with optional OpenRouter-powered vision review. This indicates the plugin’s main user-facing value is orchestrating design edits and verification, not general code generation or broad repository tooling.
